items.source:
An event that encapsulates the augmented arguments extracted from a tool input, along
with the associated tool definition and raw input data.
items.translation: 封装了从工具输入中提取的增强参数、相关工具定义以及原始输入数据的事件。

items.source:
Represents an extended argument type with additional metadata such as description
and required status.
items.translation: 表示带有额外元数据（如描述和必填状态）的扩展参数类型。
